name: comp-491
title: Date Range Calendar
description: A single month of dates in a rounded dark panel. Clicking one day then another circles both in white and shades every day between them, with arrows either side of the month name to change month.
use: Someone must pick a run of consecutive days, such as a booking, a trip or a report window.
avoid: Only one month is shown at a time, so a range crossing into the next month takes extra arrow clicks.
a11y: Days are real buttons inside a labelled grid and arrow keys move between them; nothing explains the two-click range rule to a screen reader. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bordered black panel holds "November 2026" between two small angle arrows, a row of two-letter weekday names, and five weeks of white numbers on black. Chosen days become white circles, the days inside the range sit in a grey band, and a tiny caption sits below.
behaves: Pressing a day sets one end of the range; moving the pointer across later days stretches a preview band to that day, and pressing again fixes the other end. The frames show the same range rebuilt from 10-13 to 5-10.
customise: The opening range of today plus three days and the caption link are written in the file; borders, padding and month navigation come from the shared calendar.
weight: light: One month of plain date buttons; nothing animates.
